retention_period_days.description: Number of days of history that must be retained.
retention_period_days.rationale: This setting controls operational data retention duration and does not directly impact authentication, authorisation, or access security.

identity.description: Identity used by DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_identity).
identity.rationale: Identity configuration affects how permissions and access are managed for the DatasetConfig resource.

name.rationale: The identity name is an informational output field and does not influence security policies or permissions.

type.description: Type of identity to use for the DatasetConfig. Possible values are: `IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_CONFIG`, `IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_PROJECT`.
type.rationale: A per-config identity supports better isolation and limits the risk of broad permissions being reused across configurations.

location.rationale: DatasetConfig should be created only in approved Australian regions to meet location control requirements.

dataset_config_id.description: The user-defined ID of the DatasetConfig
dataset_config_id.rationale: The dataset configuration ID is used only for identification purposes and does not affect security controls or permissions.

organization_number.description: Organization resource ID that the source projects should belong to. Projects that do not belong to the provided organization are not considered when creating the dataset.
organization_number.rationale: This value is mainly used for organisational filtering and does not directly introduce a security risk.

include_newly_created_buckets.description: If set to true, the request includes all the newly created buckets in the dataset that meet the inclusion and exclusion rules.
include_newly_created_buckets.rationale: New buckets should be manually reviewed before being included in Storage Insights datasets.

description.description: An optional user-provided description for the dataset configuration with a maximum length of 256 characters.
description.rationale: The description field is informational only and does not influence security behaviour or access management.

source_projects.description: Defines the options for providing source projects for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_source_projects).
source_projects.rationale: Source project settings are used for selecting resources and do not directly enforce authentication or security controls.

project_numbers.description: The list of project numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
project_numbers.rationale: Project numbers are used for identifying source resources and do not directly impact security policies or access management.

source_folders.description: Defines the options for providing source folders for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_source_folders).
source_folders.rationale: Source folder settings are mainly used for resource grouping and do not directly control authentication or security enforcement.

folder_numbers.description: The list of folder numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
folder_numbers.rationale: Folder numbers are administrative identifiers used for selecting resources and do not directly affect security controls.

organization_scope.description: Defines the options for providing a source organization for the DatasetConfig.
organization_scope.rationale: Organization scope should be disabled unless there is formal approval for organisation-wide monitoring.

include_cloud_storage_locations.description: Defines the options for including cloud storage locations for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_include_cloud_storage_locations).
include_cloud_storage_locations.rationale: Cloud storage location selection can affect data residency, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

locations.description: The list of cloud storage locations to include in the DatasetConfig.
locations.rationale: Only approved Australian Cloud Storage locations should be included in the DatasetConfig.

exclude_cloud_storage_locations.description: Defines the options for excluding cloud storage locations for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_exclude_cloud_storage_locations).
exclude_cloud_storage_locations.rationale: Excluded storage locations are mainly used for filtering resources and do not directly impact authentication or access control.

locations.description: The list of cloud storage locations to exclude in the DatasetConfig.
locations.rationale: This setting is used for filtering excluded storage locations and does not directly affect security enforcement or permissions.

include_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Defines the options for including cloud storage buckets for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_include_cloud_storage_buckets).
include_cloud_storage_buckets.rationale: Bucket inclusion settings are mainly used for selecting resources and do not directly modify authentication or access control policies.

cloud_storage_buckets.description: The list of cloud storage buckets/bucket prefix regexes to include in the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_include_cloud_storage_buckets_cloud_storage_buckets).
cloud_storage_buckets.rationale: Included bucket settings are operational resource selection configurations and do not directly affect security enforcement.

exclude_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Defined the options for excluding cloud storage buckets for the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_exclude_cloud_storage_buckets).
exclude_cloud_storage_buckets.rationale: Bucket exclusion settings are mainly used for filtering resources and do not directly affect authentication or security controls.

cloud_storage_buckets.description: The list of cloud storage buckets/bucket prefix regexes to exclude in the DatasetConfig. Structure is [documented below](#nested_exclude_cloud_storage_buckets_cloud_storage_buckets).
cloud_storage_buckets.rationale: Excluded bucket configurations are operational filtering settings and do not directly impact permissions or security enforcement.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument specifies the project context only and does not directly introduce security risks or enforce security controls.

link_dataset.description: Setting this field to true while creation will automatically link the created dataset as an additional functionality. -> **Note** A dataset config resource can only be destroyed once it is unlinked, so users must set this field to false to unlink the dataset and destroy the dataset config resource.
link_dataset.rationale: Dataset linking should be disabled by default and enabled only after approval.

cloud_storage_buckets.rationale: Cloud storage bucket settings are mainly used for resource selection and filtering and do not directly affect authentication or security enforcement.

bucket_name.description: The list of cloud storage bucket names to exclude in the DatasetConfig. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.
bucket_name.rationale: Bucket names are resource identifiers used for configuration purposes and do not directly impact access control or security policies.

bucket_prefix_regex.description: The list of regex patterns for bucket names matching the regex. Regex should follow the syntax specified in google/re2 on GitHub. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.
bucket_prefix_regex.rationale: Regex patterns are used for bucket matching and filtering purposes and do not directly affect security controls or permissions.
